scope: planning only; no new implementation or qualification credited
authority: tasks.json; this scheduling view adds no master tasks or acceptance authority

eligibility.source: Every parent start_after must have current accepted completion; inspect fresh master evidence/status, never a frozen lane snapshot. Active/blocked/planned predecessor does not release drafting.
eligibility.completion: Union start_after and accept_after accepted, plus unchanged task checks/evidence.
eligibility.migration: Exact row_gates govern row drafting/acceptance; group unions govern whole-group complete. Retained rows require if_retained_accept_after.
eligibility.stealing: Select highest critical-path ready unowned slice, then another deps-ok source/review item. Reserve exact paths; progress records explicit writer transfer. Queue is a default assignment, not a new dependency.
eligibility.blocked: Keep affected acceptance blocked. Unknown host/service unblock delay means no finite final-completion forecast.

resources.serialization: One writer for shared compiler/catalogue/runtime files, formatting, commits, caller activation and old-harness retirement. Heavy phases do not overlap other heavy execution. Register scratch cleanup before allocation and keep compact evidence.
resources.batching: Compatible ready I slices may share one bounded build with separate scope R/N/S/A controls and receipts. Never require an unrelated slice merely to fill a batch.

worker_b: K05 after explicit worker C domain handoff
K08 after K07 and P29 reaccept
integrator: Review K05 true C-entry hook and bounded independent controls
Revalidate P29 immediately after P12 acceptance

helper_delegation.paths: Delegate only tests/native-can/src/capabilities/iNN/ and tests/native-can/examples/capabilities/iNN/ after parent start_after. Integrator writes shared catalogue/generator/runtime/emitter/checker. Disjoint sub-deliveries may run together, keeping one parent identity.

edge_audit.meaning: Advisory denotes a redundant DIRECT edge with exact alternate accepted-prerequisite witness; all edges and predecessor artifacts remain mandatory. Start redundancy requires another start predecessor, never an accept-only alternative.

reason_templates.load_bearing: Task requires the accepted predecessor output/authority identified by its canonical title at this phase; no other retained prerequisite guarantees it before drafting (start_after) or completion (accept_after).
reason_templates.advisory_retained: Accepted first witness predecessor implies the complete dependency-direction chain to this predecessor. The direct edge is redundant at this phase, but all predecessor outputs/acceptance and every ledger edge remain required.

edge_audit.reason_resolution: Apply reason_templates[classification] with exact task/predecessor/phase; canonical task title identifies required artifact/authority and the stored witness proves advisory redundancy.

cost_estimates.unit: Hypothetical reviewer/integrator attention hours with no measured basis; not agent-runtime estimates or elapsed execution forecasts.
cost_estimates.rule: Migration default max(2,0.75 hours per original row); explicit complex-group overrides. Sub-deliveries do not inflate totals.
cost_estimates.sensitivity: 0.5x-2x for attention; excludes coding, external-host/service unblock, retained measurements, heavy execution and findings-induced requalification.
cost_estimates.blocked: P13/P14 weights are review AFTER a qualifying mechanism/profile exists; unknown unblock time is not treated as zero completion time.

critical_path.graph: Union start_after/accept_after governs accepted completion; row-incremental schedule is finer and does not alter aggregate complete.
critical_path.algorithm: Topological dynamic programming: finish[v]=weight[v]+max(finish[p] for p in union dependencies), max(empty)=0; lexicographically greatest path tie-break. Full topology weights every task 1. Residual weights verified complete tasks 0 and every other task a selected unit/attention cost. Recompute using fresh corrected master; blocked elapsed duration remains unknown.
critical_path.resource_bound: Sum all noncomplete per_task weights is the attention lower bound if one integrator performs all review. It is separate from the unlimited-writer DAG path. Peer evidence preparation can reduce the integrator portion, never acceptance obligations.
critical_path.status_source: Recomputed from current tasks.json; rerun the recurrence after any status/dependency correction. No frozen status list is authoritative.

subdelivery_rules.start: Parent start_after accepted before drafting/local checks. No new IDs.
subdelivery_rules.completion: Independent slice evidence; parent complete requires full unchanged acceptance plus both dependency lists.
subdelivery_rules.evidence: Each slice records exact paths/commits/checks/controls/identities/review/cleanup under the parent evidence file; retain per-row/file controls.

contract_refs.acceptance: tasks.json task acceptance field is authoritative for every task assignment.
contract_refs.evidence: tasks.json task evidence field, including any existing artifact names, is authoritative.
contract_refs.row_gate: migration-tasks.json matching task row_gates; use exact row start/accept/if_retained prerequisites.
